name: Modify Memory

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

upcast.text: You can alter older memories: up to 7 days ago with a level 6 slot, 30 days with level 7, 365 days with level 8 and any time with level 9.

summary: Wis save or you can rewrite up to the last 24 hours of a creature's memories.
text: On a failure the target is Charmed (and Incapacitated, unaware of its surroundings) while you work on its memory; taking damage or being targeted by a spell ends the spell. The change takes hold once you finish within the duration.
